books.title: The Green Frog
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A green frog sits on a log. His name is Fred.
Fred hops into the pond. Splash! The water is cool.
Fred sees a fly. He sticks out his long tongue.
Fred eats the fly. Yum! That was a good lunch.
Fred hops back to his log. He sings a happy frog song.

books.title: Mia's Apple Tree
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: Mia has an apple tree. It grows in her garden.
In spring the tree has pink flowers. Mia smells them.
In summer the apples grow big and red. Mia waits and waits.
Mia picks an apple. She takes a big bite. Crunch!
Mia shares the apples with her friends. They all say, 'Yum!'

books.title: The Blue Bird
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A blue bird lives in a tall tree. Her name is Bella.
Every morning Bella sings. Her song wakes up the sun.
One day Bella finds a small red feather. She puts it in her nest.
Bella's nest is soft and warm. She lays three little eggs.
Soon three baby birds hatch. Bella sings them a sweet song.

books.title: The White Rabbit
books.author: Yently Kids
pages: A white rabbit lives in a hole. Her name is Snow.
Snow hops in the grass. Hop, hop, hop!
Snow sees a big carrot. It is orange and sweet.
She pulls the carrot out. Crunch, crunch! Yum!
Snow hops home to her little ones. They eat the carrot too.
